supersedes: loan_collateral_structure_v1, which is technically invalid because only 408 rows survived incompatible channel-history intersections
v2_only_change: Remove unrestricted-purpose, secured-finance and settlement channel-share z-scores after unlabeled continuity diagnostics. Retain aggregate nontraditional credit, utilization, breadth, concentration, total-credit share, securities-firm share and three 20-day changes.
hypothesis: Historically continuous aggregate nontraditional securities-backed credit balances, utilization and concentration add stable 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and already-tested traditional aggregate margin factors.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t TaiwanStockLoanCollateralBalance.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks present on each source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.treatment_scope: Historically continuous aggregate nontraditional credit measures. Traditional margin remains in the control; discontinuous channel shares are excluded.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are reduced to one immutable daily aggregate row and are not retained.

features: log nontraditional-credit balance and daily balance change
nontraditional share of total observed credit
20-day changes in log balance, utilization and total-credit share
feature_transform: All 11 retained features use only date-t and earlier observations, standardized over a causal 252-row window with at least 126 rows.
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this v2 manifest. No result-dependent feature, threshold, date, horizon, subgroup or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: The nontraditional-credit treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise every new credit directional coefficient remains zero.
